name: Thistlefur Village
summary: In Ashenvale, Thistlefur furbolgs attack outsiders who approach their village north of Astranaar. Corruption has taken hold of the tribe, making the village dangerous to travelers.

sections.title: A Corrupted Den
sections.body: Among Ashenvale’s woodland communities, Thistlefur Village lies north of Astranaar. Corruption has maddened the Thistlefur furbolgs. They guard the paths through their settlement and attack travelers who draw near. Dal Bloodclaw and Rorgish Jowl lead the clan as fierce chieftains. Their aggression threatens nearby settlements and those traveling the roads.

faq.answer: Thistlefur Village lies in west-central Ashenvale, among woodland communities in the hills directly north of Astranaar.

faq.q: Why are the furbolgs here attacking travelers?
faq.answer: Corruption spreading through Ashenvale has driven the Thistlefur furbolgs mad. They see outsiders as enemies and attack anyone who approaches their territory.
Dal Bloodclaw and Rorgish Jowl lead the Thistlefur furbolgs as fierce warrior chieftains.

faq.q: Does Thistlefur Village pose a danger to Astranaar?
faq.answer: Yes. Thistlefur Village lies immediately north of Astranaar, and its aggressive furbolgs threaten night elf scouts, supply lines, and sentries along the central roads.

angles.text: For centuries, night elves lived in harmony with Ashenvale’s native furbolg tribes. The Thistlefur’s corruption so close to Astranaar brings heartbreak and a grave security crisis for the Sentinels.
The Thistlefur tribe’s fall warns of the lingering taint afflicting Ashenvale’s spirits and wildlife. The Cenarion Circle must remain vigilant in cleansing it.
